text:
elaine.p: Quick ask from marketplace: can we introduce a 'reserved consumption floor' SKU tied to HW-bundles? Objective is to reduce sticker shock for Dedicated+HW bundles and improve renewal velocity. Thoughts on structure + renewal incentives?

mike.sales: I prefer a consumption floor (min commit) rather than a deep upfront discount. Keeps ARR predictable. Draft idea: 12-month minimum at ~60% of list with overage credits that roll forward.

anya.prod: If we set 60% for 12m, we MUST attach onboarding credits and SI milestones so the customer sees value before renewal—otherwise renewal risk is high.

elaine.p: +1. Want a concrete 90-day customer playbook tied to the SKU. SI involvement early is mandatory.

-suresh.si: From SI POV, we can run a 90-day ramp: Week 1 deploy (P0), Weeks 2-6 performance tuning (P1), Weeks 7-12 knowledge transfer + ops handoff (P2). Request an SKU like "HW-BUNDLE-PRIME" to map service credits: e.g., 4 deployment days + 8 optimization days.

mike.sales: Add a renewal sweetener: 3% extra discount if they commit to a 10% uplift and renew before month 9. Incentivizes early renew and gives us predictability without big concession at sign.

liam.legal: Legal flags: (1) conditioned discounts linked to deliverables need clear SOW language to avoid implied obligations, (2) define whether floor payment is refundable, recommend non-refundable portion, (3) specify downgrade/delisting path. I'll draft term language.

anya.prod: Suggest two productized SKUs: "Starter Reserved" (lower floor, limited HW entitlement) + "Enterprise Reserved" (higher floor, SI premium, co-marketing). Makes renewal conversations simple.

elaine.p: Great. Also need comms for the marketplace listing + joint HW partner announcement. @suresh.si what's a realistic SI timeline for enablement and announcement?

-suresh.si: Recommend pilot with 3 customers week 1, public marketplace listing week 4, joint partner webinar week 6. SI needs enablement docs and playbooks by end of week 2.

deploy-bot: snapshot: marketplace pilot form = 8 leads, region preference us-west-2, avg requested capacity 2-4 GPUs. Link: https://go.redwood/marketplace-pilot :eyes:

mike.sales: Renewal cadence suggestion: automated milestone emails day 60 (usage + ROI), day 180 (renewal nudge + early-renew CTA), day 270 (final reminder). Combine with AE and SI success calls.

anya.prod: We'll need telemetry hooks surfaced in the console for those emails: tokens saved (caching), latency SLOs met, cost per 1k tokens. Engineering to add counters and downloadable reports.

elaine.p: Action items: @mike.sales create tiered discount grid + renewal cadence; @anya.prod productize Starter/Enterprise reserved SKUs; @suresh.si build 90-day SI ramp + enablement checklist; @liam.legal draft contract language for non-refundable floor + deliverable-linked credits. Sync Thurs 11am PT.

liam.legal: I'll circulate a draft term sheet Wed EOD.

-suresh.si: I'll drop the enablement checklist into the partnership folder and ping SI channel.

mike.sales: I'll prepare pricing sample and a customer-facing renewal email draft.

elaine.p: Thanks team. Tight timeline helps kick off HW partner co-marketing sooner. :rocket: :thumbsup:

mike.sales: Also recommend an escape clause for HW delays: pro-rata credits if HW delivery delayed beyond 30 days. @liam.legal can add caps and mitigation steps.

liam.legal: Will include pro-rata credit language with a maximum cap and specified remediation steps.

elaine.p: Ok meeting Thurs to finalize the playbook and pricing grid.
